context.body: The Scene closes with Moses saying that trouble has followed his speaking and that rescue has not yet appeared.
context.label: The closing words

observations.body: Moses and Aaron ask Pharaoh to let the people go and hold a feast in the wilderness.
observations.label: The request

observations.body: Pharaoh removes the supply of straw while keeping the same daily number of bricks.
observations.label: The quota remains

observations.body: Israelite officers appeal to Pharaoh after being beaten for missing a quota they cannot reduce.
observations.label: Officers are beaten

observations.body: Pharaoh calls the people idle, the officers confront Moses and Aaron, and Moses returns to the LORD.
observations.label: Blame moves

payload.posture: Follow request, refusal, changed labor, appeal, blame, and Moses’ return to the LORD in textual order.
payload.tension: The first request for release is followed immediately by heavier labor, unchanged quotas, beatings, and no visible rescue at the close.
payload.title: The first demand worsens the work
